verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents reschedule/cancel flows directly on bookings (accepted/pending statuses), webhooks firing on BOOKING_RESCHEDULED/BOOKING_CANCELLED for downstream sync, calendar connections (Google, Apple, etc.) and conferencing apps that update everywhere, plus scheduling policies (schedules, round-robin configs, custom booking fields) enforced at booking time. This covers the core invitee self-service reschedule/cancel plus calendar sync and policy enforcement described in the docs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that invitee-facing reschedule/cancel links actually work end-to-end in production, and no explicit documentation of the invitee-facing confirmation-page UI behavior itself (only API-level reschedule endpoint is evidenced).
